PAGE TITLE: FINANCIAL SECTION | FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, NOTES, AND REQUIRED SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION
01 NOTE 1 Reporting Entity and Summary of Significant Accounting Policies (CONTINUED)

KEY FACTS:
- Property, Plant, and Equipment (PP&E) are capitalized assets with acquisition costs of $500,000 or more, and a useful life of two years or more.
- Capitalized costs for internal use software include the full costs incurred during the software development stage only.
- For internal use software, NASA capitalizes costs when the total projected cost is $1 million or more, and the expected useful life is two years or more.
- In FY 2024, NASA implemented the requirements under SFFAS 54, Leases.
- Under SFFAS 62, Transitional Amendment to SFFAS 54, NASA has elected the transitional accommodation related to "embedded leases" through September 30, 2026.
